name: corpus-11-tools
description: Stable Corpus 11.x living discipline with bounded routing, explicit release continuity, 49 capability wrappers, provenance, generic experiment labs, and enforced separation from project research.

interface.shortDescription: Living discipline for bounded analysis and audit
interface.longDescription: A stable, versioned plugin package implementing Corpus 11.x as one evolving analytical discipline. It routes only relevant capabilities, lets the installed release speak for the current body, preserves lineage, provenance and user agency, and keeps research evidence distinct from active product rules, deployment and general validity.
